text_blocks.snippet: Shigellosis, an infection caused by Shigella bacteria, is typically treated with antibiotics to shorten the duration of illness and prevent complications. In mild cases, rest and rehydration with fluids can be sufficient. However, for severe cases or those at higher risk, antibiotics like ciprofloxacin, trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole, or ampicillin may be prescribed. Antimicrobial susceptibility testing is recommended to guide antibiotic selection due to increasing antibiotic resistance.
